weeklyWatch.label: This week's watch
weeklyWatch.text: Two official dates fall in the next 30 days: FCA and PRA consultation deadlines fall on 22 October. The EU AI Act Article 50(2) transition and new prohibitions follow on 2 December. Later dates include EIOPA’s Solvency II application on 30 January 2027 and an HKMA target date on 1 March 2027. DORA has applied since 17 January 2025; no later DORA milestone is confirmed in this 90-day window.
